mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by the Verona Public Library, a third quarter moon, and if you are a night owl, the ISS will be visible for a minute starting at 3:35 AM, moving from the northwest toward the east. Expect an overnight low of 73 degrees with rain moving in overnight.

The city has launched two major initiatives. First, the Military Ridge State Trail is being paved with new bridges to ensure year-round access for everyone. Second, a new public art piece, the Tai Chi Animal Frolics, was installed at Century School Park to celebrate art and nature.
We have a busy schedule! Today you can find Yoga at Insight Wellness or join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy event on August 30, a vehicle versus bicyclist crash occurred on East Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for the driver.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the tasty Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to head out and enjoy a treat this evening.
